full_prompt_en: A square stop-motion clay scene shows a lanky handmade figure perched on a rough earthen platform, holding a small boxy camera toward two smaller companions. The set has a dark, softly blurred background, so the warm brown clay forms stand forward in a pool of light. On the upper left platform, the tall figure sits sideways with bent legs and raised hands. Its large round ears, protruding muzzle, wide eyes, and unruly dark hair are shaped from visibly uneven clay. A reddish sweater and narrow dark trousers have ridges and scuffs that make the clothing feel modeled by hand rather than sewn. Two smaller figures stand on the uneven ground to the right, with rounded heads, oversized ears, and simple expressive faces. One is nearer the center and the other stands a little farther right, both looking toward the raised camera. A small group of clay props lies between them on the platform. At the lower center, a narrow set of chunky steps descends toward the foreground; their edges are blunt, cracked, and dusty. A blurred seated form occupies the far left foreground, partly framing the little scene and reinforcing the shallow depth of field. Warm light falls from above and slightly left, catching noses, hair ridges, and step edges while soft brown shadows collect in the recesses. The clay surface shows fingerprints, crumbly texture, and slight irregularities across every scale, from faces to rocks. The overall composition feels like a tiny stage, with a clear group interaction set inside tactile warm earth tones and dark surrounding space.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形定格黏土场景呈现一个瘦长的手塑人物坐在粗糙土台上，举着小方盒相机朝向两个更小的同伴。布景后方深暗而柔焦，因此暖棕黏土形体在一汪光中向前突出。左上方平台上，高个形体侧坐，双腿弯曲，双手抬起。大圆耳、突出的口鼻、睁大的眼睛和凌乱深发，都由明显不匀的黏土塑成。一件红褐毛衣和狭窄深裤带棱纹与擦痕，使衣服显得手塑而非缝制。两个小形体站在右侧不平地面上，圆头、大耳，面容简单而有表情。一个靠近中央，另一个稍靠右，两者都看向举起的相机。平台上二者之间散着一小组黏土道具。下方中央，一道窄窄的厚实台阶通向前景；边缘钝圆、开裂而多尘。最左侧前景还有一道模糊坐姿形体，局部为小场景框景，也强调浅景深。暖光从上方略偏左落下，照亮鼻尖、发丝棱纹和台阶边缘，柔棕色影子聚在凹处。从面孔到岩块，各种尺度的黏土表面都带指痕、松碎肌理和轻微不规则。整体构图像一座微型舞台，清楚的群体互动被可触的暖土色和深色周围空间包住。
style_prompt_en: The image has the miniature physicality of stop-motion clay, with rounded molded forms, blunt edges, and visible fingerprints. Warm ochre, reddish brown, and muted tan dominate against a softly dark background. Directional studio light makes small ridges and chipped surfaces catch highlights, while gentle recess shadows reveal thickness and scale. The focal area is compact and carefully staged; foreground and distant layers fall out of focus at different rates. Slight asymmetry and handcrafted irregularity keep the scene lively. The result is playful and tactile, with depth arising from real-looking materials rather than smooth digital finish.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有定格黏土的微型实体感，形体圆润塑成，边缘钝厚，可见指痕。暖赭、红褐和低调浅棕占主导，身后是柔化的暗背景。定向影棚光让小棱纹和缺损表面接住亮点，柔和凹影揭示厚度与尺度。焦点区域紧凑且有意布置；前景与远层以不同速度失焦。轻微不对称与手作不规则让场景活泼。结果俏皮而可触，纵深来自真实感材料，而非平滑数字完成面。
theme_en: A clay figure photographing two smaller companions on a rough earthen set
theme_zh: 一个黏土人物在粗糙土台上给两个小同伴拍照
name: Claymation
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
